(()=>{'use strict';
const TAU=Math.PI*2;const palettes={
 school:{light:'#ffeab7',mid:'#be9774',dark:'#66594f',edge:'#466e53',grass:'#87c75d',detail:'#e3c4a1',metal:'#5f7787',glow:'#ffd45b'},
 cafeteria:{light:'#f6eee0',mid:'#bbd1cd',dark:'#52747b',edge:'#26565a',grass:'#7cd5bf',detail:'#d8e9db',metal:'#577e91',glow:'#ffcf68'},
 label_lab:{light:'#e6faff',mid:'#b1c8d8',dark:'#597187',edge:'#285b72',grass:'#8bdddc',detail:'#dee8f0',metal:'#598aa9',glow:'#a6f5e0'},
 garden:{light:'#fff1c7',mid:'#bc9e75',dark:'#6e6553',edge:'#477b58',grass:'#8ad874',detail:'#edd4aa',metal:'#6c8b70',glow:'#ffd56b'},
 celebration:{light:'#ffe6cf',mid:'#bf8fa2',dark:'#76536d',edge:'#865b97',grass:'#df9ae1',detail:'#f5c6d6',metal:'#8c658f',glow:'#ffe47f'}
};
const tiles=new Map();const hash=(a,b,c=0)=>{let x=Math.sin(a*34.121+b*11.99+c*17.447)*43758.5453;return x-Math.floor(x)};
function round(c,x,y,w,h,r,fill){if(w<=0||h<=0)return;c.fillStyle=fill;c.beginPath();c.roundRect(x,y,w,h,Math.min(Math.max(r,0),w/2,h/2));c.fill()}
function line(c,x,y,x2,y2,color,width=2){c.strokeStyle=color;c.lineWidth=width;c.lineCap='round';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x,y);c.lineTo(x2,y2);c.stroke()}
function ellipse(c,x,y,rx,ry,color){c.fillStyle=color;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(x,y,rx,ry,0,0,TAU);c.fill()}
function grad(c,x,y,w,stops){const g=c.createLinearGradient(x,y,x+w,y);for(const [t,col] of stops)g.addColorStop(t,col);return g}
function vgrad(c,y,h,stops){const g=c.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+h);for(const [t,col]of stops)g.addColorStop(t,col);return g}
function centerText(c,text,x,y,size,color='#fff8e2',stroke='#243b4c'){c.save();c.font=`1000 ${size}px ui-rounded, system-ui`;c.textAlign='center';c.lineJoin='round';c.strokeStyle=stroke;c.lineWidth=Math.max(2,size*.16);c.strokeText(text,x,y);c.fillStyle=color;c.fillText(text,x,y);c.restore()}
// Broad nonrepeating illustrated ground panels. Seeded from their world chunk, rather
// than repeating the same short wall image from top to bottom of every viewport.
// Panels are cached per scene and chunk, so the expensive brushwork runs once.
function groundPanel(scene,chunk){
 const key=`${scene}:${chunk}`;if(tiles.has(key))return tiles.get(key);
 const p=palettes[scene]||palettes.school,W=640,H=500;
 const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=W;canvas.height=H;
 const c=canvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:false});const industrial=scene==='cafeteria'||scene==='label_lab';
 const festival=scene==='celebration',garden=scene==='garden';
 const rng=(row,col,pass=0)=>hash(chunk*131+col,row*19+pass,pass*11+chunk*17);
 const base=vgrad(c,0,H,industrial?[[0,p.mid],[.16,p.dark],[.83,'#344957'],[1,'#2b3a43']]:festival?[[0,'#ad816a'],[.23,'#6e5866'],[1,'#352e42']]:[[0,'#ad947a'],[.20,'#655d53'],[1,'#363c39']]);
 round(c,0,0,W,H,0,base);
 if(industrial){
  // Industrial bases have large deliberately staggered manufactured panels,
  // not the exact same stone-grid appearance as the schoolyard.
  for(let row=0;row<11;row++){
   const y=row*49+5,step=124,offset=((row%3)*41+chunk*17)%step;
   for(let col=-2;col<8;col++){
    const x=col*step-offset,variation=rng(row,col),light=scene==='cafeteria';
    const top=light?(variation>.5?'#b6d3cf':'#90b9bd'):(variation>.5?'#bdd7e4':'#87b4c9');
    round(c,x+3,y,step-7,44,3,top);
    round(c,x+8,y+4,step-17,5,2,light?'rgba(241,255,245,.28)':'rgba(229,250,255,.33)');
    line(c,x+6,y+40,x+step-7,y+40,light?'#587c81':'#4c7694',2);
    for(const bx of [x+15,x+step-17])ellipse(c,bx,y+33,2.5,2.5,light?'#597d80':'#517690');
    if((row+col+chunk)%4===0){
     round(c,x+27,y+18,step-52,14,2,'rgba(39,83,94,.45)');
     for(let slit=0;slit<4;slit++)line(c,x+37+slit*17,y+22,x+43+slit*17,y+22,'rgba(187,229,225,.75)',2);
    }
   }
  }
 }else if(festival){
  // Celebration stage: wide timber paneling with thick separated beams.
  for(let row=0;row<13;row++){
   const y=row*39+4;const l=rng(row,2),tint=l>.66?'#c69678':l>.32?'#b47f70':'#976970';
   round(c,0,y,W,35,3,tint);round(c,0,y+2,W,3,2,'rgba(255,226,173,.23)');
   for(let col=0;col<7;col++){const x=col*109+((row%2)*54)-30;
    line(c,x,y+4,x,y+31,'rgba(76,48,54,.50)',2);
    ellipse(c,x+11,y+23,2,2,'#594d52');}
  }
  for(let k=0;k<3;k++){
   const x=k*246+73+(rng(k,7)-.5)*30;
   line(c,x,22,x+10,260,'rgba(108,69,77,.3)',5);
  }
 }else{
  // Irregularly dimensioned chiseled masonry and soft foliage. Each stone gets
  // unique tint, edge light, cracks and grain, without a visible 224px repeat.
  for(let row=0;row<11;row++){
   const y=row*46+5,step=123,offset=((row%3)*41+19)%step;
   for(let col=-2;col<8;col++){
    const x=col*step-offset+(rng(row,col)-.5)*4;
    const w=step-7+rng(row,col,2)*5;
    const v=rng(row,col,3);
    const fill=v>.8?'#c6af90':v>.6?'#b7a18d':v>.35?'#a89480':'#918579';
    const yy=y+(rng(row,col,4)-.5)*2;
    round(c,x+3,yy,w,39,7,fill);
    round(c,x+8,yy+4,w-10,5,3,'rgba(255,241,209,.25)');
    line(c,x+7,yy+35,x+w-1,yy+35,'rgba(54,54,54,.19)',2);
    if(v>.73){const xx=x+16+rng(row,col,5)*(w-30);
      line(c,xx,yy+9,xx+4,yy+18,'rgba(86,83,74,.25)',1.6);
      line(c,xx+4,yy+18,xx-2,yy+23,'rgba(86,83,74,.25)',1.3);}
    for(let j=0;j<3;j++){const fx=x+11+rng(row*3+j,col)*Math.max(1,w-20),fy=yy+11+rng(row,col*5+j)*18;
      ellipse(c,fx,fy,1.3,1,'rgba(70,75,68,.18)');}
   }
  }
  // Natural vine growth occurs in intermittent rooted clusters, not every tile.
  for(let k=0;k<(garden?3:2);k++){
   const x=68+k*(garden?238:340)+(rng(k,8)-.5)*55,len=72+rng(k,9)*137;
   const green=garden?'#629663':'#53845d';
   line(c,x,3,x-6,len,'rgba(43,96,51,.43)',3);
   for(let j=0;j<7;j++){
    const yy=18+j*len/7,xx=x-6+Math.sin(j*2.3+k)*8;
    ellipse(c,xx-5,yy,8,4,green);
    ellipse(c,xx+4,yy+7,6,3,green);
   }
  }
 }
 // Depth naturally darkens below the walkable lip, improving platform readability.
 const shade=vgrad(c,0,H,[[0,'#00000000'],[.5,'#1b2a3230'],[1,'#0c1b3060']]);round(c,0,0,W,H,0,shade);
 if(tiles.size>36){const first=tiles.keys().next().value;tiles.delete(first)}
 tiles.set(key,canvas);return canvas;
}
function ground(c,world,cam,cw,t){const p=palettes[world.scene]||palettes.school,groundY=567;
 const span=640,start=Math.max(0,Math.floor(cam/span)-1),end=Math.ceil((cam+cw+span)/span);
 for(let chunk=start;chunk<=end;chunk++){
  const x=chunk*span-cam;if(x<-span||x>cw+span||x>world.width+80)continue;
  c.drawImage(groundPanel(world.scene,chunk),x,groundY,span,500);
 }
 // Exact physical walkable lip. The warm upper edge is never covered by the artwork.
 round(c,0,567,cw,11,0,'#243c41');round(c,0,560,cw,8,0,p.edge);
 round(c,0,555,cw,6,0,p.grass);round(c,0,553,cw,3,0,p.light);
 if(world.scene!=='cafeteria'&&world.scene!=='label_lab'){
  for(let x=Math.floor(cam/94)*94;x<cam+cw+95;x+=94){const sx=x-cam;
    if(hash(x,8)>.27){ellipse(c,sx,555,7,3,p.grass);ellipse(c,sx-5,551,3,4,'#a6d17c');}
    if(hash(x,12)>.80){ellipse(c,sx+9,551,2.6,2.6,'#fff1a4');ellipse(c,sx+13,550,2,2,'#f0b9c4')}
  }
 }
 for(const g of world.gaps||[]){const x=g.x-cam;if(x>cw+60||x+g.w<-60)continue;
  round(c,x,549,g.w,550,0,'#285f71');round(c,x+3,552,g.w-6,6,0,'#a3dad4');
  for(let u=0;u<g.w;u+=34){line(c,x+u+4,579+Math.sin(t*2+u)*6,x+u+22,578+Math.sin(t*2+u)*6,'#8ecfd3',2)}
  if(world.state.lever&&g.bridgeBy==='lever')bridge(c,x,553,g.w,t);
  line(c,x,553,x,967,p.light,6);line(c,x+g.w,553,x+g.w,967,p.light,6);
 }
}
function bridge(c,x,y,w,t){round(c,x-6,y+6,w+12,22,3,'#604933');for(let i=0;i<w;i+=24){round(c,x+i,y,22,20,2,(i/24)%2?'#b17e58':'#d4a26d');line(c,x+i+5,y+4,x+i+19,y+4,'#f2d6a3',1.5)}
 for(let sx of [x+5,x+w-5]){line(c,sx,y+5,sx,y-49,'#725637',4);ellipse(c,sx,y-49,5,5,'#f6cc8b')}
 line(c,x+5,y-44,x+w-5,y-44,'#8c6649',3);
}
function platform(c,world,p,cam,t){const theme=world.scene,clr=palettes[theme]||palettes.school;const x=p.x+(p.moving?Math.sin(t*TAU/(p.period||3))*(p.amplitude||60):0)-cam,y=p.y,w=p.w;
 if(x>c.canvas.width+1000||x+w<-250)return;
 const illustration=window.ALLY_ILLUSTRATIONS?.['platform_'+theme];
 if(illustration?.complete&&illustration.naturalWidth){
  c.save();
  if(p.moving){const mid=p.x+p.w/2-cam;line(c,mid-70,268,mid+70,268,'#866d55',7);
   for(const side of [-1,1]){const sx=mid+side*48,tx=x+w/2+side*w*.34;line(c,sx,271,tx,y,'#ad956e',3);ellipse(c,sx,268,7,7,'#f4e0ae')}}
  c.shadowColor='rgba(23,43,41,.31)';c.shadowBlur=10;c.shadowOffsetY=7;
  c.drawImage(illustration,x-11,y-13,w+22,66);c.shadowBlur=0;c.shadowOffsetY=0;
  // Outline the exact y collision plane with thin warm light, no fake higher ledge.
  round(c,x+1,y,w-2,2,1,'rgba(255,247,218,.65)');
  c.restore();return;
 }
 c.save();c.shadowColor='rgba(6,24,37,.34)';c.shadowBlur=11;c.shadowOffsetY=7;
 if(theme==='cafeteria'||theme==='label_lab'){
  // Steel workstation shelf, metallic side geometry, visibly walkable top.
  round(c,x-6,y,w+12,26,5,vgrad(c,y,26,[[0,'#f8f8e7'],[.24,clr.mid],[1,clr.dark]]));c.shadowBlur=0;
  round(c,x+4,y+17,w-8,6,2,'#334d62');for(let i=0;i<Math.floor(w/42);i++){line(c,x+14+i*42,y+5,x+22+i*42,y+5,'#f6ffed',2)}
  if(!p.moving){for(const side of [17,w-18]){round(c,x+side-6,y+22,12,19,3,'#617985');ellipse(c,x+side,y+45,6,6,'#314755')}}
 }else if(theme==='garden'){
  // Thick timber garden bridge/planter with leaf trim.
  round(c,x-6,y,w+12,26,5,vgrad(c,y,26,[[0,'#e6b77b'],[1,'#644f3b']]));c.shadowBlur=0;
  for(let k=11;k<w;k+=36){line(c,x+k,y+7,x+k,y+24,'#694b36',2)}
  round(c,x-4,y-8,w+8,12,6,'#55734b');round(c,x-2,y-10,w+4,5,3,'#b5ec93');
 }else if(theme==='celebration'){
  round(c,x-6,y,w+12,29,5,vgrad(c,y,29,[[0,'#fbdab4'],[.2,'#b77d73'],[1,'#76576d']]));c.shadowBlur=0;
  for(let k=9;k<w;k+=34)line(c,x+k,y+3,x+k,y+24,'#72535d',2);
  round(c,x-6,y-9,w+12,8,4,'#efb2dd');round(c,x-4,y-12,w+8,4,3,'#fff1b6');
 }else{
  round(c,x-6,y,w+12,32,6,vgrad(c,y,32,[[0,'#dbbd96'],[.45,'#97806a'],[1,'#594b3e']]));c.shadowBlur=0;
  for(let k=0;k<w;k+=44){line(c,x+k+7,y+15,x+k+34,y+15,'#c2aa8b',2);line(c,x+k+40,y+12,x+k+40,y+29,'#735e53',2)}
  round(c,x-6,y-7,w+12,9,3,'#326f49');round(c,x-5,y-11,w+10,6,4,'#99d36f');
 }
 c.shadowBlur=0;c.shadowOffsetY=0;
 // Reliable thin rim: precise landing target aligned to world physics y.
 round(c,x-5,y-13,w+10,6,3,clr.light);round(c,x+7,y-15,w-14,3,1,'rgba(255,255,255,.8)');
 if(p.moving){ // overhead suspension; no decorative legs through the playable area
  const mid=p.x+p.w/2-cam;
  line(c,mid-76,268,mid+76,268,'#725d53',7);
  for(const side of [-1,1]){const a=mid+side*53,b=x+w/2+side*w*.36;line(c,a,271,b,y,'#9c8974',3);ellipse(c,a,268,7,7,'#eed4a4')}
 }
 c.restore();
}
function wall(c,world,w,cam,t){const theme=world.scene,p=palettes[theme]||palettes.school,x=w.x-cam,y=w.y,width=w.w,h=w.h;
 if(x>2800||x+width<-100)return;
 c.save();c.shadowColor='rgba(24,39,43,.34)';c.shadowOffsetX=-6;c.shadowBlur=14;
 let gradient=grad(c,x,y,width,[[0,p.dark],[.24,p.mid],[.59,p.light],[1,p.dark]]);
 round(c,x,y,width,h,4,gradient);c.shadowBlur=0;
 if(theme==='label_lab'){
  // Magnifier-wall is a real built-in library cabinet.
  for(let yy=y+14;yy<y+h-15;yy+=49){round(c,x+3,yy,width-6,40,2,'#426582');line(c,x+4,yy+41,x+width-4,yy+41,'#d8eafb',3);
   for(let k=0;k<3;k++)round(c,x+7+k*(width-14)/3,yy+7,(width-17)/3,27,1,['#ffe1a9','#b7cde9','#f1b8ca'][(k+Math.round(yy/49))%3]);}
 }else if(theme==='cafeteria'){
  // Installed cafeteria equipment, riveted stainless panels.
  for(let yy=y+10;yy<y+h-14;yy+=47){round(c,x+4,yy,width-8,39,3,'#76969a');round(c,x+7,yy+4,width-14,8,2,'#cbe0d4');ellipse(c,x+width-10,yy+26,2.6,2.6,'#405c68')}
 }else if(theme==='garden'||theme==='celebration'){
  for(let yy=y+20;yy<y+h-10;yy+=27){line(c,x+5,yy,x+width-5,yy,'#735d4d',2);
   ellipse(c,x-2+Math.sin(yy)*3,yy,7,4,'#67a85c');ellipse(c,x+width+2,yy+8,8,5,'#76b464')}
 }else{
  for(let yy=y+18;yy<y+h;yy+=32){line(c,x+2,yy,x+width-2,yy,'#786e60',2);
   const mx=x+(Math.round(yy/32)%2?.35:.68)*width;line(c,mx,yy,mx,Math.min(y+h,yy+32),'#807460',2)}
  for(let yy=y+25;yy<y+h;yy+=51){ellipse(c,x-3,yy,8,4,'#7ca566');ellipse(c,x+width+3,yy+11,6,5,'#56895a')}
 }
 round(c,x-8,y-14,width+16,12,3,theme==='label_lab'?'#d4f2ff':p.light);
 round(c,x-6,y-17,width+12,4,2,'#fff9dc');
 // Guide tile is integrated as a carved plaque rather than an alien detached arrow.
 if(theme!=='cafeteria'){round(c,x+4,y+20,width-8,38,4,p.edge);centerText(c,'↑',x+width/2,y+47,28,p.glow,p.dark)}
 c.restore();
}
function conveyor(c,cv,cam,t){const x=cv.x-cam,y=548,w=cv.w;
 round(c,x-8,y-14,w+16,32,8,'#3f5c69');round(c,x-4,y-10,w+8,18,6,'#a6cdd4');round(c,x,y-7,w,11,4,'#4b7f8b');
 for(let k=0;k<w/36;k++){const u=(k*36+t*80*cv.dir)%(w-26);round(c,x+8+u,y-5,21,7,2,'#e4f2e6')}
 for(const z of [x+10,x+w-10]){ellipse(c,z,y+11,7,7,'#435d65');ellipse(c,z,y+11,3,3,'#dff4e9')}
}
function cart(c,x,y,world,t,carrying=false){c.save();c.translate(x,y);
 c.shadowColor='#18364744';c.shadowBlur=11;round(c,-43,-50,87,46,6,'#658894');c.shadowBlur=0;
 round(c,-42,-49,84,11,5,'#d7ebe4');round(c,-36,-38,72,22,4,'#b6d4cc');
 for(const xx of [-26,26]){ellipse(c,xx,-1,11,11,'#2b5663');ellipse(c,xx,-1,5,5,'#bad4d9')}
 round(c,-19,-56,40,7,3,'#e5ceab');round(c,-14,-68,27,12,5,'#f9de88');
 c.fillStyle='#4c7481';c.font='900 12px system-ui';c.textAlign='center';c.fillText(carrying?'ARRIVED':'TRAY',0,-18);c.restore()}
function taskObject(c,task,world,cam,t){const x=task.x-cam,y=567,id=task.id,done=world.state.done.has(task.id),p=palettes[world.scene];
 if(done&&task.kind==='npc')return;
 c.save();c.translate(x,y);
 if(task.kind==='pickup'){
   // Pedestal and mechanically collectible item, not a giant glowing emoji.
   ellipse(c,0,1,26,7,'#243c4255');round(c,-13,-29,26,27,5,p.mid);round(c,-19,-33,38,7,3,p.light);
   c.fillStyle=p.glow;c.font='32px system-ui';c.textAlign='center';c.shadowColor=p.glow;c.shadowBlur=8;c.fillText(task.icon,0,-44+Math.sin(t*3)*3);c.shadowBlur=0;
 }else if(task.kind==='lever'){
   round(c,-26,-42,53,43,7,'#4d6771');round(c,-20,-38,40,34,4,'#8baaa2');
   c.save();c.translate(0,-22);c.rotate(done?-.7:.7);line(c,0,0,0,-40,'#e8b56c',7);ellipse(c,0,-41,10,10,'#f8d384');c.restore();
   round(c,-26,-49,52,6,3,'#d6ddd3');
 }else if(world.scene==='label_lab'){
   // Information station: visible label, real inspector opens using E.
   round(c,-58,-86,116,83,9,'#4b758c');round(c,-52,-81,104,70,6,'#d9e9e9');round(c,-47,-72,94,54,3,'#fffcef');
   for(let k=0;k<4;k++)round(c,-36,-61+k*11,72-k*8,3,1,k%2?'#94afba':'#c4d5d8');
   round(c,-64,-99,128,16,5,'#315768');centerText(c,id==='magnifier'?'MAGNIFY':`READ ${id.replace('label','')}` ,0,-87,13,'#fff6c9');
 }else if(world.scene==='cafeteria'){
   // Serve/verify station with cart and physical equipment.
   round(c,-54,-88,108,80,7,'#517d80');round(c,-49,-82,98,56,4,'#d9e6d8');
   round(c,-39,-73,78,29,5,'#a3c3bd');for(let k=0;k<3;k++)ellipse(c,-25+k*24,-57,9,9,'#e8f4e6');
   round(c,-59,-99,118,17,5,'#385968');centerText(c,id==='ari'?'TEAM DESK':id==='station2'?'CLEAN GEAR':id==='station1'?'VERIFY':'ART',0,-86,12,'#ffea98');
 }else if(world.scene==='garden'){
   round(c,-63,-59,126,53,8,'#a78660');round(c,-57,-62,114,10,4,'#efcf9b');for(let v of [-45,45]){round(c,v-7,-8,15,16,4,'#6c594b')}
   for(let k=0;k<5;k++)round(c,-42+k*20,-77,16,13,3,['#f0a5bc','#87c8e3','#e9cd7c'][k%3]);
   centerText(c,id==='crafts'?'ART & CRAFTS':id==='music'?'MUSIC':'PARTY',0,-83,13,'#fff6d0');
 }else if(world.scene==='celebration'){
   round(c,-50,-58,101,51,7,'#836480');round(c,-56,-63,112,11,5,'#eeb6ce');
   round(c,-47,-76,95,17,5,'#83678a');centerText(c,id==='team'?'TEAM UP':'CELEBRATE',0,-63,11,'#fff3b8');
 }else{
   // Authentic school activity board: a sign set into its own scene props.
   round(c,-46,-67,92,61,7,'#745b49');round(c,-40,-62,80,48,4,'#f2dfad');centerText(c,'ALLY',0,-30,18,'#53766a');
 }
 // Arranged objects stay in the game world. Partial progress is visible as well.
 const moves=world.state.activityStages?.[id]||[],count=moves.length;
 if(count>0||done){
  c.save();
  // Tiny inset workbench indicator lights are sufficient; no text plaques over faces.
  round(c,-33,-108,66,13,6,done?'#246859':'#365773');
  for(let k=0;k<3;k++)ellipse(c,-21+k*21,-102,4.5,4.5,k<count?'#f5df86':'#8198b2');
  if(['crafts','station3'].includes(id)){
    round(c,-44,-177,88,45,4,'#f4eddc');
    const motifs=['★','♥','✿'];for(let j=0;j<(done?3:count);j++)centerText(c,motifs[j],-26+j*26,-145,26,['#e5a254','#d97dbd','#60aa95'][j]);
  }
  else if(id==='music'){
    round(c,-44,-163,89,38,5,'#eacb87');
    for(let j=0;j<(done?4:count);j++)centerText(c,j%2?'♫':'♪',-28+j*19,-136,25,'#7750a0');
  }
  else if(id==='welcome'){
    round(c,-49,-180,98,44,5,'#78baa8');centerText(c,done?'EVERYONE':`WELCOME ${count}`,0,-156,12,'#fff6c3');
    if(done)centerText(c,'BELONGS!',0,-143,10,'#fff6c3');
  }
  else if(id==='game'){
    round(c,-50,-178,100,42,4,'#d2cbaa');centerText(c,done?'3 CLUES FOUND':'SCAVENGER MAP',0,-157,11,'#396e78');
    for(let j=0;j<(done?3:count);j++)ellipse(c,-27+j*28,-146,4,4,'#438b70');
  }
  else if(id==='station2'||id==='check'){
    for(let j=0;j<(done?3:count);j++){
       round(c,-42+j*31,-146,24,25,4,'#dfebd8');centerText(c,'✓',-30+j*31,-129,17,'#287f75');
    }
  }
  else if(id==='station1'){
    round(c,-43,-155,88,30,5,'#beddd5');centerText(c,done?'TRAY AT HELPER':'TRAY TO REVIEW',0,-135,10,'#305d6d');
  }
  c.restore();
 }
 if(done){round(c,-18,-21,36,23,7,'#2f9c79');centerText(c,'✓',0,-4,20,'#fff')}

 c.restore();
}
function finish(c,world,cam,t){const x=world.finishX-cam,p=palettes[world.scene]||palettes.school;if(x>2000||x<-130)return;
 c.save();c.translate(x,567);
 for(const sx of [-22,82]){round(c,sx,-175,11,175,4,p.dark);round(c,sx+2,-168,4,155,2,p.light)}
 const flag=vgrad(c,-160,73,[[0,world.color],[1,p.edge]]);round(c,-17,-158,102,73,9,flag);
 round(c,-11,-153,90,6,3,'rgba(255,255,255,.47)');centerText(c,'GOAL',33,-118,23,'#fff7cc');centerText(c,'★',33,-89,21,'#ffe171');
 for(let k=0;k<4;k++)ellipse(c,-8+k*26,-167+Math.sin(t*2+k)*3,3,4,p.glow);
 c.restore()}
function backfill(c,scene,cw,cam,time){
 const isGarden=scene==='garden',p=palettes[scene]||palettes.school;
 // Built from actual layer-appropriate foliage, fences and distant garden fixtures.
 // This intentionally contains NO baked character or fake traversable platform.
 c.save();const band=vgrad(c,383,185,[[0,'#95b9b300'],[.35,isGarden?'#a9cabe':'#b7b9ba'],[1,isGarden?'#779d80':'#9c9fb1']]);
 round(c,0,383,cw,188,0,band);
 const base=Math.floor(cam*.27/184)*184-184;
 for(let worldX=base;worldX<cam*.27+cw+200;worldX+=184){const sx=worldX-cam*.27,v=hash(worldX,13),yy=487+v*25;
  c.save();c.globalAlpha=.66;
  // Backmost tree canopy, softly clustered to complement readable playable platforms.
  for(let k=0;k<7;k++){
   const x=sx-56+k*21,y=yy-25+Math.sin(k*1.5+v*5)*14;
   ellipse(c,x,y,31+(k%2)*8,34,isGarden?(k%3?'#6e9d76':'#8eb28a'):(k%2?'#9a9db4':'#89a4a2'));
   ellipse(c,x-7,y-9,16,14,isGarden?'#b5cf9b':'#b6bfbb');
  }
  if(Math.round(worldX/184)%3===0){
   round(c,sx-46,506,101,50,6,isGarden?'#8c9a7d':'#8e8a8f');
   round(c,sx-43,507,94,7,2,isGarden?'#d3d6ae':'#c7b1a7');
   for(const at of [-35,38]){round(c,sx+at,515,4,33,2,'#6e857c')}
  }
  if(isGarden){for(let k=0;k<5;k++){
   const x=sx-58+k*24,yy=535+(k%2)*9;ellipse(c,x,yy,7,7,['#d3abcf','#faf0c0','#ddc1d8'][k%3]);
   ellipse(c,x+9,yy+8,12,7,'#729b70')
  }}
  c.restore();
 }
 // Layered vertical fence establishes location without implying any collision.
 for(let x=-((cam*.27)%73);x<cw+75;x+=73){
   round(c,x,499,7,66,3,isGarden?'#d6dfc5':'#c7afbd');
   round(c,x-3,489,13,12,4,isGarden?'#e6e8cb':'#e1c6c2')
 }
 line(c,0,528,cw,528,isGarden?'rgba(229,237,201,.7)':'rgba(227,207,215,.6)',6);
 c.restore();
}
window.ALLY_FOREGROUND={ground,platform,wall,conveyor,taskObject,cart,finish,backfill,palettes};
})();
</script><script>/** Stage 12 interactive stations: data only, no web requests or account information. */
const STATION_GAMES={
 station1:{mode:'sequence',title:'Adult verification handoff',brief:'Move the tray through a real review sequence. The cart has already arrived; food suitability is determined by the trusted adult using the friend’s own plan.',
  items:[['tray','🛒','Delivered tray'],['helper','🧑‍🍳','Trusted adult review'],['details','📋','Current product information'],['guess','👀','Guess from appearance']],
  steps:[['tray','Put the delivered tray on the inspection desk'],['details','Attach the current ingredients and preparation information'],['helper','Ask the trusted adult to review the individual plan']]},
 station2:{mode:'sort',title:'Prevent cross-contact',brief:'Move used equipment away from the serving area. Equipment identified as unused and provided by an adult belongs at the clean station. Appearance alone cannot confirm equipment is suitable.',
  items:[['used-spoon','🥄','Used spoon'],['fresh-kit','🧰','Adult-provided unused kit'],['used-tongs','🍴','Used tongs']],
  zones:[['return','USED EQUIPMENT · RETURN'],['adult','ADULT-ISSUED EQUIPMENT']],targets:{'used-spoon':'return','fresh-kit':'adult','used-tongs':'return'}},
 station3:{mode:'art',title:'Make a food-free table mural',brief:'Choose three colorful decorations and place them on the paper mural. Everyone can join this non-food activity.',
  items:[['sun','☀️','Sunshine'],['star','⭐','Star'],['heart','💜','Heart']],steps:[['one','Left poster'],['two','Center poster'],['three','Right poster']]},
 crafts:{mode:'art',title:'Design the garden welcome poster',brief:'Place three non-food shapes on the garden poster. You can choose their order; all friends can help create the display.',
  items:[['flower','🌼','Flower'],['ribbon','🎀','Ribbon'],['leaf','🍃','Leaf']],steps:[['one','Left panel'],['two','Center panel'],['three','Right panel']]},
 music:{mode:'rhythm',title:'Start a welcoming music beat',brief:'Follow the original four-beat pattern and start a group dance. Everyone can participate without a food activity.',
  items:[['clap','👏','Clap'],['bell','🔔','Bell'],['drum','🥁','Drum']],pattern:['clap','drum','clap','bell']},
 welcome:{mode:'sequence',title:'Build an inclusive welcome sign',brief:'Place three welcoming messages in a helpful order: listen, make space, then invite without pressure.',
  items:[['invite','🌟','Invite everyone'],['listen','👂','Listen first'],['space','🪑','Make room'],['exclude','🚫','Only friends with the same snacks']],
  steps:[['listen','Hear what the friend wants'],['space','Provide an accessible activity space'],['invite','Invite them without pressure']]},
 game:{mode:'hunt',title:'Team scavenger hunt',brief:'Find three hidden non-food objects in the activity box. A scavenger hunt can include friends with different food needs.',
  items:[['balloon','🎈','Balloon'],['apple','🍎','Decoration apple'],['map','🗺️','Team map'],['scarf','🧣','Friendship scarf'],['cake','🎂','Party cake'],['cup','🥤','Drink cup']],targets:['balloon','map','scarf']},
 check:{mode:'sort',title:'Plan inclusive help',brief:'Sort each question to a trusted adult or a friendship activity. Food safety is individualized: do not decide a snack is safe for somebody else.',
  items:[['food','🥪','Food ingredient question'],['label','📦','Unclear package label'],['game','🎲','Friend wants an activity']],
  zones:[['adult','TRUSTED ADULT · FOOD REVIEW'],['play','FRIENDSHIP · ACTIVITY IDEAS']],targets:{food:'adult',label:'adult',game:'play'}}
};
function validateStationGames(){for(const [id,g] of Object.entries(STATION_GAMES)){
 if(!['sequence','sort','art','rhythm','hunt'].includes(g.mode))throw Error('Invalid station '+id);
 if((g.items||[]).length<3)throw Error('Missing station items '+id);
 if((g.mode==='sequence'||g.mode==='art')&&g.steps.length!==3)throw Error('Missing placement steps '+id);
 if(g.mode==='sort'&&Object.keys(g.targets).length!==g.items.length)throw Error('Missing sorting targets '+id);
 if(g.mode==='rhythm'&&g.pattern.length<3)throw Error('Missing rhythm '+id);
 }}
validateStationGames();
if(typeof window!=='undefined')window.ALLY_STATION_GAMES=STATION_GAMES;
if(typeof module!=='undefined')module.exports={STATION_GAMES,validateStationGames};
</script><script>(()=>{'use strict';
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s),el=(tag,cl='',text='')=>{let e=document.createElement(tag);if(cl)e.className=cl;if(text)e.textContent=text;return e};
const clamp=(n,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,n));const lerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;const TAU=Math.PI*2;
const storeKey='allyquest.welcome.five.v1',prefsKey='allyquest.five.preferences.v1';
function loadJSON(k,f){try{return {...f,...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k)||'null')}}catch{return {...f}}}
let progress=loadJSON(storeKey,{unlocked:1,completed:{},selected:null,totalStars:0});let preferences=loadJSON(prefsKey,{mute:false,reducedMotion:matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches,largeControls:false});

function update(dt){if(!world||!player||gameMode!=='playing'||paused||world.state.winning)return;

 const direction=(keyboard.right||touch.right?1:0)-(keyboard.left||touch.left?1:0);
 const jumpHeld=keyboard.jump||touch.jump;

  p.x+=now-before;
 }else p.support=null;}
 p.vx=lerp(p.vx,vxGoal,Math.min(1,dt*(p.grounded?15:8)));
 if(direction)p.face=direction;

 const wantsJump=keyboard.jumpTap||touch.jumpTap;
 if(wantsJump){p.jumpBuffer=.15;keyboard.jumpTap=false;touch.jumpTap=false}
 p.jumpBuffer=Math.max(0,p.jumpBuffer-dt);p.coyote=p.grounded?.115:Math.max(0,p.coyote-dt);
 if(p.jumpBuffer>0&&(p.grounded||p.coyote>0)){

 }
 p.stride=(p.stride||0)+Math.abs(p.x-oldX);
 const oldY=p.y;
 // Variable height and a slower apex help players steer toward an intended surface.

 p.vy=Math.min(1350,p.vy+gravity*dt);p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.grounded=false;p.support=null;
 for(const wall of world.walls||[]){const xHit=p.x+20>wall.x&&p.x-20<wall.x+wall.w;
  const yHit=p.y>wall.y&&p.y-112<wall.y+wall.h;
  if(xHit&&yHit){
   // 8px lip-assist: avoid unfair clipping while preserving tall bounce-only walls.
   if(p.vy<0&&p.y-wall.y>0&&p.y-wall.y<9&&oldY<=wall.y+9){p.y=wall.y;p.vy=0;p.grounded=true;continue}
   if(oldX<=wall.x-19){p.x=wall.x-21;p.vx=0}
   else if(oldX>=wall.x+wall.w+19){p.x=wall.x+wall.w+21;p.vx=0}
  }
 }
 for(const pad of world.springs||[]){
  // Solid frame when walking: a trampoline is approached from above, never through its metal legs.
  if(p.y>pad.y+6&&p.y-110<pad.y+38){
   if(oldX<pad.x-20&&p.x+20>pad.x){p.x=pad.x-21;p.vx=0}
   else if(oldX>pad.x+pad.w+20&&p.x-20<pad.x+pad.w){p.x=pad.x+pad.w+21;p.vx=0}
  }
  if(p.vy>=0&&p.x>pad.x-14&&p.x<pad.x+pad.w+14&&oldY<=pad.y+11&&p.y>=pad.y){

  }
 }
 for(const platform of world.platforms){const x=platform.x+(platform.moving?Math.sin(timeElapsed*TAU/(platform.period||3))*(platform.amplitude||60):0);

 }
 const gap=(world.gaps||[]).some(g=>p.x>g.x&&p.x<g.x+g.w&&(!(world.state.lever&&g.bridgeBy==='lever')));
 if(!gap&&p.vy>=0&&oldY<=582&&p.y>=567){p.y=567;p.vy=0;p.grounded=true;p.springFlight=false;p.coyote=.115;if(oldY<557){emit('land',p.x,p.y);p.landTimer=.17}}
 if(p.y>810){p.x=p.checkpointX||95;p.y=567;p.vy=0;p.vx=0;p.grounded=true;p.springFlight=false;p.support=null;world.state.attempts++;setPrompt('Try again! You are back at your checkpoint.',1.7);emit('land',p.x,p.y)}
 p.bounceTimer=Math.max(0,p.bounceTimer-dt);p.landTimer=Math.max(0,p.landTimer-dt);

function emit(type,x,y){if(training&&(type==='jump'||type==='bounce'||type==='pick')){training.flags[type]=true;updateTraining({})}if(type==='jump')sound('jump');if(type==='land'&&!preferences.reducedMotion)sound('land');if(type==='bounce'){sound('bounce');shake=3.2}if(type==='pick')sound('pick');spawn(x,y,type==='bounce'?28:type==='pick'?20:7)}
function spawn(x,y,n=16){if(preferences.reducedMotion)n=Math.min(n,3);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=TAU*i/n,v=65+Math.random()*140;particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*v,vy:Math.sin(a)*v-100,age:0,life:.35+Math.random()*.35,color:['#ffdf4b','#a6ffcc','#85d2ff','#ff98d0'][i%4]})}if(particles.length>180)particles.splice(0,particles.length-180)}
function oval(x,y,rx,ry,color){ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,rx,ry,0,0,TAU);ctx.fill()}
function rect(x,y,w,h,color,r=0){ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(x,y,w,h,Math.max(0,r));ctx.fill()}
function starShape(x,y,r,color='#ffcf30',outline='#fff4a1'){ctx.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<10;i++){const a=-Math.PI/2+i*Math.PI/5,R=i%2===0?r:r*.47;const xx=x+Math.cos(a)*R,yy=y+Math.sin(a)*R;i?ctx.lineTo(xx,yy):ctx.moveTo(xx,yy)}ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.shadowColor='#ffd736';ctx.shadowBlur=15;ctx.fill();ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.strokeStyle=outline;ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.stroke()}
function image(name,x,y,w,h){const im=art[name];if(im?.complete&&im.naturalWidth>0){ctx.drawImage(im,x,y,w,h);return true}return false}
function drawGround(){kit.ground(ctx,world,cam,cw,timeElapsed)}
function drawPlatforms(){for(const p of world.platforms){const px=p.x+(p.moving?Math.sin(timeElapsed*TAU/(p.period||3))*(p.amplitude||60):0)-cam;
 if(px>cw+160||px+p.w<-150)continue;kit.platform(ctx,world,p,cam,timeElapsed);
}}
function drawSpecial(){for(const wall of world.walls||[]){const x=wall.x-cam;if(x>cw+160||x+wall.w<-150)continue;kit.wall(ctx,world,wall,cam,timeElapsed)}
 for(const pad of world.springs||[]){const px=pad.x-cam;if(px>cw+140||px+pad.w<-160)continue;
 ctx.save();if(player.bounceTimer>0&&Math.abs(player.x-pad.x-pad.w/2)<90){const f=Math.sin((1-player.bounceTimer/.27)*Math.PI)*.17;ctx.translate(px+pad.w/2,pad.y+6);ctx.scale(1+f*.36,1-f);ctx.translate(-px-pad.w/2,-pad.y-6)}
 if(!image('trampoline',px-13,pad.y-12,pad.w+26,52)){oval(px+pad.w/2,pad.y+8,pad.w/2,13,'#163b96');starShape(px+pad.w/2,pad.y-3,17)}ctx.restore();
 }
 for(const cv of world.conveyors||[]){if(cv.x-cam>cw+150||cv.x+cv.w-cam<-100)continue;kit.conveyor(ctx,cv,cam,timeElapsed)}
 if(world.id==='cafeteria'&&world.state.cartX!==undefined){kit.cart(ctx,world.state.cartX-cam,564,world,timeElapsed,world.state.cartDelivered)}
}
function drawStarsAndTasks(){for(let i=0;i<world.stars.length;i++){if(world.state.stars.has(i))continue;const st=world.stars[i],x=st.x-cam;if(x<-60||x>cw+60)continue;starShape(x,st.y+Math.sin(timeElapsed*2.7+i)*3.5,17,'#ffe16e')}
 for(const task of world.tasks){if(world.state.done.has(task.id)&&task.kind==='pickup')continue;
 const x=task.x-cam;if(x<-180||x>cw+180)continue;
 if(task.kind==='npc'){ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=world.state.done.has(task.id)?.85:1;drawSprite(npcName(task),x,567,0,player.x<x?-1:1,true);ctx.restore()}
 else kit.taskObject(ctx,task,world,cam,timeElapsed);
 }
 // Activity boards now display progress through real foreground objects.
}
/** Frame-coherent animation; the illustrated pose keeps the same 256x256 foot anchor. */
function drawSprite(who,x,foot,pose=0,face=1,npc=false){
 const height=npc?141:145, im=art[who+'_'+String(pose).padStart(2,'0')]||art[who+'_00'];
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,foot);if(face<0)ctx.scale(-1,1);
 // The atlas has a common bottom edge at row 247, not 256. Anchor that edge to the physical foot.
 if(npc||player.grounded)oval(0,1,25,5,'#132b324e');
 if(!npc&&!preferences.reducedMotion&&player.grounded&&player.landTimer>0){const k=player.landTimer/.17;ctx.scale(1+k*.055,1-k*.06)}
 if(im?.complete&&im.naturalWidth){const poseScale=(pose===4||pose===6)?0.92:1;const h=height*poseScale;ctx.drawImage(im,-h/2,-h*247/256,h,h)}
 if(!npc&&progress.scarf&&progress.scarf!=='none'){const clr={gold:'#ffdd72',mint:'#8fe0c1',lavender:'#d8b3fa'}[progress.scarf];if(clr){rect(-10,-height*.40-7,21,5,clr,2);rect(8,-height*.40-6,6,13,clr,2)}}
 ctx.restore();
}
function characterPose(who,p){if(!p.grounded)return p.vy<-45?5:6;if(p.landTimer>.075)return 4;if(Math.abs(p.vx)<25)return 0;const run={ethan:[1,2,3,2],maya:[2,1,2,3],leo:[2,1,2,3],ari:[2,1,2,3]};return (run[who]||run.ethan)[Math.floor((p.stride||0)/29)%4]}

function drawFinish(){kit.finish(ctx,world,cam,timeElapsed)}
function drawBackground(){ctx.save();const yMin=-verticalPad,yMax=720+(ch-720-verticalPad);
 ctx.fillStyle=world.scene==='cafeteria'?'#b6d0c8':world.scene==='label_lab'?'#baddec':'#84bfe0';ctx.fillRect(0,yMin,cw,yMax-yMin+30);
 const imageSrc=art[world.scene+'_play']||art[world.scene]||art.school;
 if(imageSrc?.complete&&imageSrc.naturalWidth){const sw=imageSrc.naturalWidth,sh=imageSrc.naturalHeight;
  const ratio=Math.min(sw,cw*sh/570),sx=clamp(cam/Math.max(1,world.width-cw)*(sw-ratio),0,Math.max(0,sw-ratio));
  // Wide panoramic art supplies scenery only, while independently drawn interactive foreground stays crisp.
  ctx.globalAlpha=backgroundOpacity;
  if(world.scene==='garden'||world.scene==='celebration'){
    ctx.drawImage(imageSrc,sx,0,ratio,sh*.53,0,-verticalPad,cw,430+verticalPad);
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;kit.backfill(ctx,world.scene,cw,cam,timeElapsed);
  }else ctx.drawImage(imageSrc,sx,0,ratio,sh,0,-verticalPad,cw,Math.max(570+verticalPad,650));
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
 }
 const haze=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,150,0,580);haze.addColorStop(0,'rgba(231,242,238,0)');haze.addColorStop(.7,'rgba(231,242,238,.07)');haze.addColorStop(1,'rgba(218,233,216,.30)');ctx.fillStyle=haze;ctx.fillRect(0,140,cw,450);
 // The painted skyline already establishes atmospheric depth. Avoid geometric
 // repeated semicircles that looked like flat, out-of-place bushes.
 ctx.restore();
}
function drawDecor(){const xStart=Math.floor(cam/360)*360-360;for(let x=xStart;x<cam+cw+350;x+=360){const sx=x-cam;if(sx<-80||sx>cw+80)continue;if(x>360&&x<world.width-330){if(world.scene==='cafeteria'||world.scene==='label_lab'){ctx.font='25px system-ui';ctx.fillText(x%720?'📚':'🧪',sx+26,525)}else{oval(sx+22,556,15,10,'#5a984b');oval(sx+41,552,13,15,'#7dae60');oval(sx+15,550,12,9,'#c7dc76')}}}
 if(world.scene==='celebration'||world.scene==='garden'){for(let x=160;x<world.width;x+=340){const sx=x-cam;if(sx<-100||sx>cw+100)continue;ctx.strokeStyle='#efdf9a';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(sx,200);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx+170,222,sx+340,200);ctx.stroke();for(let j=0;j<8;j++){ctx.fillStyle=['#ffd462','#ed98b4','#8fddc3','#bd9df4'][j%4];ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(sx+j*44,204);ctx.lineTo(sx+j*44+17,204);ctx.lineTo(sx+j*44+7,228);ctx.fill()}}}
}
function drawParticles(dt){const count=particles.length;for(let i=count-1;i>=0;i--){const p=particles[i];p.age+=dt;p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.vy+=200*dt;if(p.age>=p.life){particles.splice(i,1);continue}ctx.globalAlpha=1-p.age/p.life;oval(p.x-cam,p.y,3.2,3.2,p.color)}ctx.globalAlpha=1}
function draw(t,dt){if(gameMode!=='playing'||!world)return;resizeIfNeeded();ctx.save();ctx.setTransform(scale*dpr,0,0,scale*dpr,0,verticalPad*scale*dpr);const look=clamp(player.vx*.23,-58,75);cam=clamp(lerp(cam,player.x-cw*(cw<780?.24:.34)+look,preferences.reducedMotion?1:.1),0,Math.max(0,world.width-cw));if(shake&&!preferences.reducedMotion){ctx.translate(Math.sin(t*120)*shake,Math.cos(t*147)*shake*.25);shake*=.83;if(shake<.3)shake=0}drawBackground();drawDecor();drawGround();drawPlatforms();drawSpecial();drawStarsAndTasks();drawFinish();drawSprite(selectedCharacter,player.x-cam,player.y,characterPose(selectedCharacter,player),player.face);drawParticles(dt);
 for(let i=confetti.length-1;i>=0;i--){let p=confetti[i];p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.x+=p.vx*dt;rect(p.x,p.y,8,14,['#ffe15c','#9eecff','#f6a7c8','#c4a1ef','#a3f2a4'][p.h]);if(p.y>730)confetti.splice(i,1)}ctx.restore();
 if(training)$('#training').classList.toggle('hidden',!!dialog||!$('#overlay').classList.contains('hidden'));
 if(dialog)positionComic();
 else if(nearTask&&nearTask.kind==='npc'&&!paused){showNpcHint(nearTask);positionComic()}
 else if($('#comic').classList.contains('quick'))$('#comic').classList.add('hidden');
}
function resizeIfNeeded(){let r=c.getBoundingClientRect();if(!c.width||Math.abs(c.width-r.width*dpr)>5||Math.abs(c.height-r.height*dpr)>5)resize()}
function loop(now){raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);const dt=Math.min(.033,(now-last)/1000||.016);last=now;if(gameMode==='playing'){if(!paused)update(dt);if(!preferences.reducedMotion)frameTime+=dt;draw(now/1000,dt);playMusic(now/1000)}}
// In-world Ally Academy tutorial: a child must actually use controls, not click a fake Next button.
function trainingCopy(){if(!training)return;const stages=[['WALK TO MAYA','Move using A/D, arrows, or touch controls.'],['TRY A REAL JUMP','Jump on the schoolyard path. Space / ↑ / JUMP.'],['SPEAK TO MAYA','Press E or tap TALK, then choose how to help.'],['SPRING INTO THE AIR','Land on the blue trampoline. It is a real obstacle!'],['COLLECT A STAR','Explore an elevated route to pick up a golden star.']];
 const i=training.index,step=stages[i];if(!step){finishTutorial();return}
 $('#training-stage').textContent=`ALLY ACADEMY ${i+1}/5`;
 $('#training-title').textContent=step[0];$('#training-copy').textContent=step[1];
 $('#training-meter').style.width=`${i/5*100}%`;
}
function updateTraining(data={}){if(!training||gameMode!=='playing')return;
 if((data.direction||0)!==0&&player.x>185)training.flags.move=true;
 const seq=['move','jump','talk','bounce','pick'];
 while(training.index<seq.length&&training.flags[seq[training.index]])training.index++;
 if(training.index>=seq.length){finishTutorial();sound('win');setPrompt('Ally Academy complete! Keep exploring.',2.5);return}
 trainingCopy();
}

 label2:{name:'PACKAGE B · EXAMPLE',ingredients:'Ingredients: oats, oil, flavoring. Additional product details are unclear.',signal:'A missing precautionary warning does not prove a food is suitable.',advice:'Ask a trusted adult to obtain reliable manufacturer and ingredient information.'},
 label3:{name:'PACKAGE C · EXAMPLE',ingredients:'NEW RECIPE · Ingredients: cocoa, soy lecithin, sugar.',signal:'Recipes change. This label names soy.',advice:'An adult checks the current package, not an old photograph.'}};
const ACTIVITY_STEPS={
 station1:['ROLL THE CART','CHECK THE ACTUAL TRAY','ASK THE CAFETERIA HELPER'],station2:['NOTICE SHARED UTENSILS','SELECT CLEAN EQUIPMENT','ASK AN ADULT TO CHECK'],station3:['CHOOSE AN ART ACTIVITY','SET OUT PAPER & MARKERS','INVITE EVERYONE'],

/** Small physical activity boards. Every station requires actual moves or taps. */
function stationProgress(a){const conf=window.ALLY_STATION_GAMES[a.task.id];if(!conf)return 0;
 if(conf.mode==='rhythm')return a.moves.length;
 return a.moves.length;
}
function stationTargetCount(conf){return conf.mode==='rhythm'?conf.pattern.length:conf.mode==='hunt'?conf.targets.length:conf.mode==='sort'?conf.items.length:conf.steps.length}
function stationComplete(a){const g=window.ALLY_STATION_GAMES[a.task.id];return stationProgress(a)>=stationTargetCount(g)}
function stationFeedback(message,success=false){const box=$('#activity-feedback');if(box){box.textContent=message;box.classList.toggle('success',success)}}
function stationTone(id){if(preferences.mute)return;initAudio();if(!sounds)return;const hz={clap:420,drum:260,bell:660}[id]||500;
 try{const o=sounds.createOscillator(),g=sounds.createGain(),t=sounds.currentTime;o.type=id==='drum'?'triangle':'sine';o.frequency.value=hz;g.gain.setValueAtTime(.001,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.045,t+.01);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,t+.18);o.connect(g).connect(sounds.destination);o.start(t);o.stop(t+.19)}catch{}
}
function stationChoosePiece(id){if(!activity)return;
 const a=activity,g=window.ALLY_STATION_GAMES[a.task.id];if(!g)return;
 if(g.mode==='rhythm'){
  const expected=g.pattern[a.moves.length];stationTone(id);
  if(id===expected){a.moves.push([id,String(a.moves.length)]);world.state.activityStages[a.task.id]=a.moves.slice();sound('pick');renderStationActivity();stationFeedback(stationComplete(a)?'Great! You played the whole original rhythm.':'Nice beat! Keep the pattern going.',true)}
  else {a.moves=[];world.state.activityStages[a.task.id]=[];renderStationActivity();stationFeedback('Try the rhythm again from the first note. Follow the highlighted beat.');}
  return;
 }
 if(g.mode==='hunt'){
  if(g.targets.includes(id)&&!a.moves.some(([item])=>item===id)){a.moves.push([id,'found']);world.state.activityStages[a.task.id]=a.moves.slice();sound('pick');renderStationActivity();stationFeedback(stationComplete(a)?'You found all three non-food team objects!':'Found a team clue! Find the next one.',true)}
  else {stationFeedback('Look for the map, balloon and friendship scarf. The food props are just scenery.');sound('wrong')}
  return;
 }
 if(a.moves.some(([item])=>item===id)){stationFeedback('That item is already in place. Try another one.');return}
 a.selected=id;renderStationActivity();stationFeedback('Selected '+g.items.find(v=>v[0]===id)?.[2]+'. Now choose where it belongs.');
}
function stationPlace(zone){if(!activity)return;const a=activity,g=window.ALLY_STATION_GAMES[a.task.id];if(!g||!['sequence','sort','art'].includes(g.mode))return;
 if(!a.selected){stationFeedback('Choose an item first, then click or drop it into a work area.');return}
 const id=a.selected;let correct=false;
 if(g.mode==='sort'){correct=g.targets[id]===zone}
 else {const next=g.steps[a.moves.length];correct=!!next&&next[0]===zone&&(g.mode==='art'||next[0]===id)}
 if(correct){a.moves.push([id,zone]);a.selected=null;world.state.activityStag
